comment: Maps each Vector game series to the firmware (OS) UF2 image it boots. Edit this file when you add or update a UF2 in this folder. 'processor' must match the silicon the UF2 targets (rp2040 = Pico W, rp2350 = Pico 2 W) and is used to refuse flashing a mismatched image. The 'nuke' entry is the universal flash-erase image used before every firmware flash.
